symbol: CBC-mode SSL/TLS cipher suites on Clerk-managed subdomains
title: Clerk: CBC-mode SSL/TLS cipher suites on Clerk-managed subdomains deprecated
summary: Beginning January 18, 2027, Clerk will stop supporting CBC-mode SSL/TLS cipher suites on Clerk-managed subdomains, including clerk.example.com (Frontend API) and accounts.example.com (Account Portal
replacement: AEAD cipher suites such as AES-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305, which modern clients already negotiate. Contact support@clerk.com if you need continued CBC support.
